legal.metaDescription: Registration details for Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla, licensed travel agency in Argentina.
legal.title: Legal information
legal.intro: Edmar Travel operates as a registered travel agency in Argentina. This page lists company identifiers, the official domain, and how to reach us for legal or administrative inquiries.

sections.title: Registered travel agency
paragraphs: Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla offers tourism experiences in Mendoza through edmartravel.tur.ar under applicable Argentine tourism regulations.
The file number listed corresponds to the National Registry of Travel and Tourism Agencies (RNAVYT).

sections.title: Use of this information
paragraphs: Data published here is for users, authorities, and partners. Official registry records prevail in case of discrepancy.
For experience bookings use the contact form or email. For privacy or cancellations see the dedicated policies in the site footer.

legal.closing: We keep this page updated as our registrations and legal obligations evolve.

privacy.metaDescription: How Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla handles personal data when you browse, book, or contact us.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla (Tax ID 20-43925089-6) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect through the site, booking and contact forms, how we protect it, and your rights under applicable law.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Controller: Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla — Tax ID 20-43925089-6 — RNAVYT file 2116.
Privacy contact: edmartravelsas@gmail.com — Domain: edmartravel.tur.ar

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: Identity and contact details: name, email, phone, country, ID document, accommodation when you submit booking or contact forms.
Experience details: preferred date, time, party size, notes or special needs.
Technical data: browser, device, language, and aggregated pages visited for security and improvement.
Cookies and preferences: as described in our Cookie Policy.

sections.title: Purposes
paragraphs: Manage booking requests, inquiries, and coordination via WhatsApp or email.
Deliver the contracted service and communicate before, during, and after the experience.
Meet legal, accounting, and registry obligations as a travel agency.
Improve the site, measure aggregated usage (when you accept analytics cookies), and maintain security.

sections.title: Legal basis and retention
paragraphs: We process data based on consent, pre-contractual or contractual performance, legitimate interests (site security), or legal obligations.
We retain information as long as needed for these purposes or as required by law.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
paragraphs: We may share minimal data with experience providers (guides, wineries, transport) to coordinate your outing.
We use infrastructure providers (hosting, email, databases) as processors under our instructions.
We do not sell personal data for unrelated commercial purposes.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.
No system is perfect; use strong passwords if you create an account and avoid sharing sensitive data through unofficial channels.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, rectification, update, or deletion where applicable, object to certain processing, and withdraw consent.
Contact edmartravelsas@gmail.com with your request; we will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla — edmartravelsas@gmail.com — edmartravel.tur.ar

privacy.closing: We may update this policy; the current version is always published on the site.

cookies.metaDescription: Cookie types used on edmartravel.tur.ar and how to manage them.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This site uses cookies and similar technologies to work properly, remember preferences, and—with your consent—analyze usage in aggregate.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Small text files stored by your browser. They help the site remember actions or preferences for a period of time.

sections.title: Essential cookies
paragraphs: Required for basic operation: security, load balancing, selected language, and cookie consent state.
They do not require prior consent because they are strictly necessary.

sections.title: Preference cookies
paragraphs: Remember choices such as language or interface settings for future visits.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
paragraphs: If you accept the banner, we may use aggregated measurement tools to understand which sections are most visited.
We do not use analytics cookies if you decline consent.

sections.title: How to disable them
paragraphs: Decline non-essential cookies from the banner when entering the site.
You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings.
Disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions: edmartravelsas@gmail.com

cookies.closing: We will update this policy if we add new cookie categories.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use of edmartravel.tur.ar and booking conditions with Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern access to edmartravel.tur.ar and general conditions for tourism experiences offered by Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla (Tax ID 20-43925089-6, RNAVYT file 2116).

sections.title: Acceptance and use
paragraphs: By browsing or using the site you accept these terms and applicable Argentine law.
You must use the site lawfully and must not attempt to compromise its security.

sections.title: Nature of the service
paragraphs: Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla organizes and intermediates experiences in Mendoza. Third parties may deliver part of the service.
Requests submitted online are not final until expressly confirmed and, where applicable, payment is agreed.

sections.title: Bookings and payment
paragraphs: Published prices are indicative until confirmation. We will communicate the final amount before closing the booking.
Available payment methods are confirmed per experience.
Bookings depend on provider availability and specific outing conditions.

sections.title: Participation
paragraphs: Activities may involve inherent risks (weather, terrain, traffic, alcohol during tastings). Assess your health and follow guide instructions.
Minors must have authorization and adult supervision when required.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Site content belongs to Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla or licensors. Reproduction without permission is prohibited.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages from site use, without prejudice to non-waivable consumer rights.
On-site delivery may be by third parties subject to their operational conditions.

sections.title: Changes and jurisdiction
paragraphs: We may update these terms; the published version applies.
Disputes fall under ordinary courts of Argentina, subject to consumer protection rules.
Contact: edmartravelsas@gmail.com

terms.closing: Thank you for choosing Edmar Travel to discover Mendoza.

cancellations.metaDescription: Cancellation, date changes, refunds, and force majeure for Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla bookings.
cancellations.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellations.intro: This policy complements the Terms and Conditions and explains how we handle cancellations, date changes, and refunds.

sections.title: Booking requests
paragraphs: Online requests require confirmation via WhatsApp or email. Until then the booking is not firm.
Specific deadlines and conditions are communicated when each experience is confirmed.

sections.title: Date changes
paragraphs: Changes depend on provider availability and how far in advance you notify us.
More notice usually allows rescheduling with fewer penalties.
Peak season or limited-capacity experiences may not allow changes; we will inform you when booking.

sections.title: Cancellations by the guest
paragraphs: Cancel in writing at edmartravelsas@gmail.com with your request reference or booking details.
Early cancellation may allow rescheduling or partial refund depending on costs already incurred.
Late cancellation or no-show may incur full or partial non-refundable charges as agreed at confirmation.

sections.title: Refunds
paragraphs: When a refund applies, it will be made via the agreed method within a reasonable time after confirming cancellation.
Bank, payment gateway, or administrative fees already incurred may be non-refundable.
We will provide a breakdown when applicable.

sections.title: Force majeure and weather
paragraphs: If an experience cannot run due to extreme weather, road closures, official measures, or force majeure, we will prioritize rescheduling.
If rescheduling is not possible, we will assess full or partial refund based on amounts already paid to third parties and applicable law.
Safety of guests and guides comes first for outdoor activities.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Cancellations and changes: edmartravelsas@gmail.com — Edgar David Nuñez Zavalla — File 2116.

cancellations.closing: Our team will work with you to find the best solution in each case.
